item.tib: ma mo sbod gtong snang srid zil gnon gyi rgyud las pra 'bebs bung ba'i dbyangs
item.coloph: ces ma mo rbod gtong snang srid zil gnon gyi rgyud las/ pra 'beb bung rtsi rol pa'i glu dbyangs 'di ni/ nye bar gnas pa'i drung yig pa ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i (mtshos) bskul pa la brten nas/ gnam lo sa pho stag gi bzhin ras ngom pa'i zla tshes la/ shar rgyal mo rgya yi rong chen gyi yul dbus chus chen rab brten rgyal po'i zhing gi ri khrod ye shes snang byed du/ snyigs ma'i kho bo kun grol grags pa'i dpal yon can gyis/ bstan 'gror bsngags pa'i lhag bsam dkar pos bgyis pa/ bstan pa'i rgyan dang sems can gyi don rgya chen por 'grub par gyur cig gi smon pa dang bcas pa i thi sarba mang+ga lam//
